title: EtaleLimitReplacementExactSystems
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preordered set and let $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ be an inverse diagram of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with affine transition morphisms. Let $(X,(f_i))$ be a limit cone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For each $i$, let $F_i$ be an abelian sheaf on $(D_i)_{\acute{e}t}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], with maps $\varphi_f:D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^{-1}F_i\to F_j$ for $f:i\to j$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] satisfying the canonical inverse-image identity and composition laws. Let $G:I\to\operatorname{Ab}(X_{\acute{e}t})$ be identified objectwise with $f_i^{-1}F_i$ by isomorphisms, its arrows being inverse-image composition followed by pullback of $\varphi_f$. Let $L$ be a colimit cocone on $G$, with coprojections $\iota_i$.  There exist a compatible injective coefficient system $A_i$ and a compatible cokernel system $R_i$, both with the canonical inverse-image identity and composition laws. Their pulled-back systems $G_A,G_R$ on $X$ have specified objectwise isomorphisms and canonical transition equations and colimit cocones $L_A,L_R$. There are stage short exact sequences $0\to F_i\xrightarrow{a_i} A_i\xrightarrow{b_i}R_i\to0$ and a short exact sequence $0\to L\xrightarrow a L_A\xrightarrow b L_R\to0$. For every $i$ there is a morphism from the inverse image of its stage short complex to the limit short complex whose first component is $e_{G,i}^{-1}\iota_i$ and third component is $e_{G_R,i}^{-1}\iota_{R,i}$. Every $A_i$ is injective. No cohomology, connecting maps or acyclicity is asserted. Here an object A is injective if every map into A extends across every monomorphism. A short exact sequence means its first arrow is monic, its second is epic, and the first image equals the second kernel [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]. The morphism of short complexes consists of three coefficient maps commuting with their two differentials.

proof.text: Obtain compatible injective and cokernel systems and their pulled-back short exact diagram from the stage-diagram theorem. This leaves the construction problem below and does not assume any colimit exact sequence.

Use Mathlib exactness of filtered colimits of abelian sheaves, restricting AB5 from universe u+1 to u via AB5OfSize_of_univLE. Apply ShortComplex.ShortExact.map_of_exact to colim. Choose the canonical colimit cocones for GI and GR; compare the canonical colimit of G with the given cocone L by its unique colimit isomorphism. Define a by the inverse comparison followed by colim.map α and define b as colim.map β. Functoriality proves a composed with b is zero, and transport of the mapped short complex across the first-object comparison proves short exactness.

Define a morphism from each component diagram to the colimit short complex using the three coprojections. Its two squares are colimit.ι_map, with the first one transported through the unique colimit comparison. Compose with the stage-diagram morphism s. The first component reduces to eG.inv followed by L.ι and the third to eGR.inv followed by the canonical GR coprojection. These are the prescribed formulas.

theorem etale_limit_replacement_exact_systems
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i j : Iᵒᵖ) (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G) (hL : IsColimit L) :
    ∃ (FR : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φR : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (FR i) ⟶ FR j)
    (hidentityR : ∀ i : I, φR (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (FR i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (FR i))
    (hcompositionR : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φR (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (FR i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φR f) ≫ φR g)
    (GR : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eGR : ∀ i : I, GR.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (FR i))
    (hGR : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), GR.map f =
      (eGR i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (FR i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φR f) ≫ (eGR j).inv)
    (LR : Cocone GR) (hLR : IsColimit LR)
    (FI : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (ψ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (FI i) ⟶ FI j)
    (hidentityI : ∀ i : I, ψ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (FI i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (FI i))
    (hcompositionI : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      ψ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (FI i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (ψ f) ≫ ψ g)
    (GI : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eGI : ∀ i : I, GI.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (FI i))
    (hGI : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), GI.map f =
      (eGI i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (FI i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (ψ f) ≫ (eGI j).inv)
    (LI : Cocone GI) (hLI : IsColimit LI)
    (a : L.pt ⟶ LI.pt) (b : LI.pt ⟶ LR.pt) (w : a ≫ b = 0)
    (hE : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact)
    (ai : ∀ i : I, F i ⟶ FI i) (bi : ∀ i : I, FI i ⟶ FR i)
    (wi : ∀ i : I, ai i ≫ bi i = 0)
    (hi : ∀ i : I, (ShortComplex.mk (ai i) (bi i) (wi i)).ShortExact)
    (t : ∀ i : I,
      (ShortComplex.mk (ai i) (bi i) (wi i)).map
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))) ⟶ ShortComplex.mk a b w),
      (∀ i : I, Injective (FI i)) ∧
      (∀ i : I, (t i).τ₁ = (eG i).inv ≫ L.ι.app i) ∧
      (∀ i : I, (t i).τ₃ = (eGR i).inv ≫ LR.ι.app i)
